BOOK ONE · LESSON 105

Full of mistakes

错误百出

The Boss asks Bob to bring Sandra to his office. He finds that Sandra's typed letter is full of mistakes - she typed 'intelligent' with only one 'L'. The Boss gives her a dictionary as a present. The lesson covers 'want/tell + object + to + verb' constructions.

105 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

  1. 1

    The Boss

    Where's Sandra, Bob? I want her.

    鲍勃，桑德拉在哪儿？我要她。

  2. 2

    Bob

    Do you want to speak to her?

    您想和她说话吗？

  3. 3

    The Boss

    Yes, I do. I want her to come to my office. Tell her to come at once.

    是的，我想。我要她到办公室来。叫她马上来。

  4. 4

    Sandra

    Did you want to see me?

    您想见我吗？

  5. 5

    The Boss

    Ah, yes, Sandra. How do you spell 'intelligent'? Can you tell me?

    啊，是的，桑德拉。'intelligent'怎么拼？你能告诉我吗？

  6. 6

    Sandra

    I-N-T-E-L-L-I-G-E-N-T.

    I-N-T-E-L-L-I-G-E-N-T。

  7. 7

    The Boss

    That's right. You've typed it with only one 'L'. This letter's full of mistakes. I want you to type it again.

    是的。但你只打了一个'L'。这封信错误百出。我要你重打一遍。

  8. 8

    Sandra

    Yes, I'll do that. I'm sorry about that.

    是的，我会的。对此我很抱歉。

  9. 9

    The Boss

    And here's a little present for you.

    这儿有一个小礼物给你。

  10. 10

    Sandra

    What is it?

    是什么？

  11. 11

    The Boss

    It's a dictionary. I hope it'll help you.

    是一本词典。我希望它能帮到你。

New words & expressions 生词和短语

spell /spel/ (spelt/spelt, spelt)
v. 拼写
intelligent /in'telidʒənt/
adj. 聪明的，有智慧的
mistake /mi'steɪk/
n. 错误
present /'preznt/
n. 礼物
dictionary /'dɪkʃənri/
n. 词典

Notes on the text 课文注释

Do you want to speak to her?

在这句话中，to speak是动词want的宾语，而这个结构——动词原形前加to——在英文中被称为动词不定式。本课用动词不定式作宾语的例句还有：I want her to come to my office; Tell her to come at once; Did you want to see me; I want you to type it again等。

full of ...

full of ...，充满了……。

And here's ...

这里and表示承上启下，使上下文紧密联系，当'于是'、'因此'讲。

03

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

Grammar I: Rewrite with 'want/tell + object + to + verb'

Rewrite the sentences, using the words given according to the examples. Example: Close all the doors. (he/want/her) → He wants her to close all the doors. Sweep the floor. (tell/her) → Tell her to sweep the floor.

仿照例句用所给的词改写下列句子。例句：关上所有的门。（他/想要/她）→ 他想要她关上所有的门。扫地板。（叫/她）→ 叫她扫地板。

Rewrite each imperative sentence using 'want/tell + object + to + verb'. Items 1 and 2 are printed examples.

Grammar II: Rewrite with 'tell/want + object + not to + verb'

Rewrite the sentences, using the words given according to the examples. Example: Don't stop. (tell/them) → Tell them not to stop. Don't swim in the river. (I/not want/you) → I don't want you to swim in the river.

仿照例句用所给的词改写下列句子。例句：不要停。（叫/他们）→ 叫他们不要停。不要在河里游泳。（我/不想/你）→ 我不想要你在河里游泳。

Rewrite each negative imperative sentence using 'tell/want + object + not to + verb'. Items 1 and 2 are printed examples.
